prompt: In some countries, owning a home rather than renting one is very importatant for people. Why might this be the case? Do you think this is a positive or negative situation?
essay:
In several countries, some people believe that it is crucial for them to own a home rather than to rent one. The main reason behind home ownership is that owning a home offers certainty and cost-effectiveness. However, I argue that this is a negative situation, because it will significantly influence housing price as well as it is going to destroy more nature.

People buying home as it brings certainty and are cheaper for a long time. When they have their own house, they can stay there for the rest of their life, and do not need to move out to another place. As renting is only for a short period of time, they need to decide whether to extend their rent or not. Furthermore, although people need a huge amount of it at the beginning to buy the building, in the long run, owning a home means saving money. This is because they do not need to pay monthly or yearly rent.

However, although buying a home is very important, I believe that this is a negative situation. First and foremost, as the demand for owning a home grows rapidly, the price will meet a new equilibrium point, shifting to its highest level. Secondly, it will bring more negative effects for the environment. For example, in Indonesia, since there is a high demand for owning a house, the local developer of housing areas will build more residential regions that usually destroy our natural landscape, such as a ricefield. Therefore, the green space will drastically decrease.

In conclusion, owning a house is crucial for some people in some countries as it provides certainty and makes people save money too. Nevertheless, I think that this situation is bad since it will significantly increase the house price and will bring a big negative impact to the environment.
